Background.hint: The core problem, limitation or opportunity that led to the work.
Research, user feedback, business requirements, analytics, stakeholder input or existing product constraints.

The work.hint: Your process, thinking, collaboration and how you moved from problem to solution.
The actual work: flows, wireframes, UI, components, prototypes, design systems, motion, testing, etc.
Accessibility, scalability, technical constraints, responsive behaviour, performance, brand consistency and so on.

The result.hint: What shipped, changed or improved. This works whether you have hard metrics or only qualitative outcomes.
The longer-term value: reusable patterns, faster delivery, future product work, team efficiency, scalability, learnings, etc.
